note: Years per SCD/Spotify-based list (some 2022-dated songs may have been released late 2021).

Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2020 (top 10 overall + top 10 Chilean songs), YouTube Chile top 10 music videos, SCD/BMAT radio ranking of Chilean songs. Spotify/YouTube overall top 10s were entirely foreign Latin urbano (reggaeton/trap from Puerto Rico, Colombia, Panama); Chilean songs come from the Chilean-only lists. Radio was dominated by female pop (Cami, Denise Rosenthal, Paloma Mami). Several home songs were released 2018-2019 but are sourced as 2020's most played. 'El baile de los que sobran' (1986) is included as the estallido-social anthem because it sits at #13 on the 2020 radio ranking; no source found naming other protest songs for 2020. No Billboard Chile Songs chart before 2022; Monitor Latino and Wikipedia annexes could not be fetched.

THIN. Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2021 (only top 5 overall and top 5 Chilean songs were published in the press) and YouTube Chile top music videos 2021. The year the Chilean urbano wave broke through (Marcianeke most-streamed Chilean artist; 'Dímelo Ma' the top Chilean song). Foreign hits are all Latin urbano. No radio (SCD) ranking for 2021 was found, so pop/cumbia/rock are not covered this year.

Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2022 (top 10 overall, top 10 Chilean songs) and YouTube Chile top 10 music videos (all ten Chilean). Peak of the Chilean urbano/reggaeton wave: Chilean songs took the top 3 of the overall Spotify list. Foreign hits are Latin urbano (Bad Bunny's 'Un Verano Sin Ti', Bizarrap, Rauw Alejandro). Home list is all urbano: no 2022 radio ranking was found, so cumbia/pop/rock are not covered. 'Pégate' also reached #1 on Billboard Chile Songs (Feb 2022).

Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2023 (top 10 overall, top 10 Chilean songs), YouTube Chile top 10 music videos, SCD/Vericast-BMAT radio ranking of Chilean songs 2023. Jere Klein's year in urbano; 'Que te vaya bien' (cumbia) was the most-played Chilean song on radio. Foreign hits are Latin urbano/pop (Feid, Karol G, Yandel, Ozuna, Myke Towers) plus Argentine cuarteto/cumbia crossover ('Un Finde'). 'Rey' (rock) is on the 2023 radio ranking (#20) and won Canción del Año at Premios Pulsar 2024. 'Llámame Bebé' was Billboard Chile Songs #1 in Jan 2023.

Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2024 (only top 5 published), SCD yearbook 'País de Músicos 2024' (radio top 50 of Chilean songs, top 50 foreign songs on Chilean radio, top 30 Chilean songs by Spotify plays and YouTube views, 'no urbano' top 15). Caveat: the yearbook's Spotify/YouTube counts for Chilean songs are worldwide plays, not Chile-only. 'Gata Only' was #1 in Chile and a global hit. Foreign entries beyond 'Luna' come from the radio ranking, which mixes Latin urbano/pop with Anglo pop; Chile-only streaming of foreign songs beyond the top 5 was not found. 'Princesita de…' was Billboard Chile Songs #1 in Jan 2024.

THIN. Sources: Spotify Wrapped Chile 2025 (only top 5 songs published), YouTube Chile top 3 music videos, SCD/Vericast radio ranking of Chilean songs 2025. Kidd Voodoo was the most-streamed Chilean artist; Bad Bunny's 'DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS' dominated the foreign side (Latin urbano; 'La Plena' is Colombian). The radio ranking is mostly catalogue: 'Las Seis' (Joe Vasconcellos, 1990s) was the most-played Chilean song on radio in 2025 and is included, flagged as an evergreen; 'Tattoo' (Zúmbale Primo, #4 radio) is listed under 2024. Only 3 foreign songs are sourced.

YEAR-TO-DATE ONLY (compiled 16 Nov 2026; no year-end lists exist yet). Built from Spotify Chile chart snapshots published during 2026: daily top 10s on 22 Jan, 19 Feb and 12 Mar (Infobae auto-generated chart posts) and the weekly chart of 12 Nov (Soundcharts). Songs that were #1 or recurred across snapshots rank highest ('SENDA BELLAKONA' #1 in Jan; 'DUBAI' #1 in Feb; 'ALO' #1 in Mar). Mid-year (Apr-Oct) is not sampled, there is no radio/YouTube/award evidence, and everything is urbano. Foreign side is Latin urbano plus Jimin's 'Who' (2024), which sat in the Chilean top 5 in all three Q1 snapshots. Release years not confirmed except where given. Treat as provisional.
